prompt:
Hi — I'm the head of supply chain for our consumer electronics import operation. We have 14 pending purchase orders sitting in /workspace/data/raw/inbound/pending_shipments.json, all inbound from APAC suppliers heading to our three European distribution hubs.

I need you to produce a structured consolidation recommendation report called consolidation_report.json. The report should tell me: how these shipments should be grouped and consolidated, which consolidation strategies are most appropriate for each group, an economic breakdown comparing consolidation against direct shipping, any timing or order window considerations we should be aware of, and a summary of the main risks we're taking on.

We have a freight reference tool installed in /workspace/scripts/script.sh that the logistics team set up. Please use it to guide your analysis — it has everything you need to know about consolidation strategy and economics. The report needs to be thorough enough that our freight forwarder can act on it directly.
